Experimental Animal Study

Abstract

This experimental study investigated the biological response to a treatment using a mouse model.

Methods

Twenty-four mice were included in the animal experiment.

The animals were housed under controlled laboratory conditions and were randomly assigned to experimental and control groups.

All animal procedures were reviewed and approved by the Institutional Animal Care and Use Committee.

Following completion of the experiment, the mice were euthanized according to the approved experimental protocol.

Results

A total of 24 mice completed the experimental protocol.

Data Availability

The data generated during this study are available from the corresponding author on reasonable request.
